the performance problems in NFV service chains can be solved by combining the performance gains from the hardware acceleration of system calls and the consolidation of the chain.
commodity software components can be leveraged for NFV service chains, but the performance of these chains must be improved by eliminating redundancy and by accelerating the chains’ execution.
